title: Channel canvas layout response (PRF-02, catalogue module #14, Vertical Stream Layout)
description: The creator/dashboard-facing read. A LAYOUT IS NOT A MODULE -- this setting consumes no 30.3 cap slot and is not one of the sixteen master-canvas module keys (migration 0147). verticalEntitled reports whether the 30.3 Pro+ render gate currently allows vertical to render -- reporting only; the gate itself lives solely inside the overlay read (app_private.list_overlay_canvas_layout). Configuring the layout is never tier-gated (12.6): a Free channel can set vertical and see it recorded here even when verticalEntitled is false.
